item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 18/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring cool weather to Guangdong today and tomorrow. Under the influence of a strong easterly airstream, it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong on Thursday and Friday. A broad band of clouds is expected to bring rainy weather to the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea over the weekend.

Date/Month: 18/01 (Tuesday)
Wind: Northeast force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Cool with one or two light rain patches in the morning. Visibility relatively low in some areas. Bright periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 16 - 18 C
R.H. range: 75 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
